form.description: Fields marked with an asterisk are required.
form.loadErrorHeading: The customer could not be loaded

form.checkingEmail: Checking whether this address is already in use...
form.phoneHint: Required once the customer is active.
form.statusHint: An active customer must have a phone number.
form.countryHint: Two letters, such as VN or GB.
form.addressNote: Leave the address empty, or fill in at least the first line, the city and the country.
form.conflictBody: This record was saved by someone else while this form was open. Reload the newest version - what you have typed stays here - and then save again. Only the fields you changed are sent, so their work is kept.
form.conflictReloaded: Reloaded. Review your changes and save again.
form.leaveBody: This form has changes that have not been saved. Leaving now discards them.

remote.updatedBody: Saving now would conflict. Reload their changes first - everything you have typed is kept.
remote.deletedBody: Another user deleted this customer while you were editing it. Your changes cannot be saved.
remote.unverifiedHeading: This record may be out of date
remote.unverifiedBody: Live updates were interrupted. Reload to be sure you are editing the latest version - what you have typed is kept.
